name: Aurochs
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. No listed languages.
appearance: A dark, heavyset wild bull with a rust-brown forelock, a shaggy neck and pale horns curling upward.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo’s Guide to Monsters, first printing, November 2016, Appendix A, Assorted Beasts, Aurochs, p. 207. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/vgtm
sections.Traits: Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Gore hit against it that turn deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Orcs devoted to Bahgtru train aurochs as war mounts while the animals are young.

name: Cow
appearance: A brown-and-cream farm cow with a pale muzzle, short curved horns and a long tufted tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo’s Guide to Monsters, first printing, November 2016, Appendix A, Assorted Beasts, Cattle, Cow, p. 207. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/vgtm
sections.Traits: Charge. If the creature moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Gore that turn, the hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Deep Rothé
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft.. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A compact, musk-ox-like bovine with a long dark brown coat and thick horns curled around its face.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo’s Guide to Monsters, first printing, November 2016, Appendix A, Assorted Beasts, Cattle, Cow and Rothé, pp. 207–208. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/vgtm
sections.Traits:
Charge. If the creature moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Gore that turn, the hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Innate Spellcasting. Charisma is the deep rothé’s spellcasting ability. It can cast Dancing Lights at will without components.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Stunted rothé from the Underdark use magical flashes to communicate with each other.
sections.Dancing Lights (2014): Action, range 120 ft., concentration up to 1 minute. Create up to four floating lights or combine them into one roughly humanoid Medium figure. Each light casts dim light in a 10-ft. radius. As a bonus action, move the lights up to 60 ft. within range. Keep separate lights within 20 ft. of another light from the spell. A light disappears if it leaves range. https://www.dndbeyond.com/spells/2057-dancing-lights

name: Dolphin
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Blindsight 60 ft.. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A slate-gray dolphin with a pale underside, a tapered snout and broad tail flukes.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Volo’s Guide to Monsters, first printing, November 2016, Appendix A, Assorted Beasts, Dolphin, p. 208. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/vgtm
sections.Traits:
Charge. If the dolphin moves at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Slam that turn, the hit deals an extra 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
Hold Breath. The dolphin can hold its breath for 20 minutes.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Adult dolphins are about 5 to 6 feet long. These social marine mammals feed on fish and squid.
